{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Load the data
data = pd.read_csv('data/trial.csv')

# Check the premises
print("Data shape:", data.shape)
print("Unique patient_id count:", data['patient_id'].nunique())
print("Total rows:", len(data))
print("Number of duplicate patient_id entries:", len(data) - data['patient_id'].nunique())
print("Arm values:", data['arm'].unique())
print("Severity values:", data['severity'].unique())
print("Assay_batch values:", data['assay_batch'].unique())
print("-999 count in biomarker_baseline:", (data['biomarker_baseline'] == -999).sum())

# Check for duplicate patient_id with different sample_seq
duplicate_patients = data[data.duplicated(subset=['patient_id'], keep=False)]
print("Duplicate patient_ids (with sample_seq):")
duplicate_patients[['patient_id', 'sample_seq', 'arm', 'biomarker_baseline']].head(10)"}
